subject.title: fix: avoid false stayed-stopped on launchd KeepAlive throttle

question: Does current main’s canonical one-second launchd throttle fully eliminate the false stopped/free verdict, or should restart-health retain an additional supervisor-aware tolerance after rebasing?
rationale: The answer determines whether this PR is superseded or needs a revised implementation; preserving the branch's ten-second assumption would reverse established launchd-owner behavior.

options.title: Treat current main as canonical
options.body: Reproduce the linked scenario on current main and close this PR if the one-second throttle keeps recovery inside the existing stopped/free threshold.

options.title: Retain defensive tolerance
options.body: Rebase while preserving the one-second default, revise the calculation around current supervisor behavior, and provide fresh launchd proof showing why extra tolerance remains necessary.

recommendation.title: Treat current main as canonical
recommendation.body: Reproduce the linked scenario on current main and close this PR if the one-second throttle keeps recovery inside the existing stopped/free threshold.

likelyOwner.reason: Merged the established launchd KeepAlive restart-owner behavior and is the clearest available owner for deciding whether that behavior supersedes this branch.
